title: Pandolfi going to Los Alamos to talk to a live alien

tellings.quote: meets and he says, "Uh I'm going to Los Alamos uh this week. I'm gonna talk to I'm talking to Live Elliot."

plain: Around 1991, Ron Pandolfi, a scientist at the CIA, the US spy agency, is said to have told people at a meeting that he was going to Los Alamos, the New Mexico nuclear weapons laboratory, that week to talk to a live alien. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron relays this, as something passed on to him, in a story that also involves the researchers Dan Smith and John B. Alexander. If true, it would mean a living non-human being was held at a government lab.
